# Arlo — Technical Operations | April 2026 Plan
**Last Updated:** 2026-04-13 (Standardized with MCF)
**Status:** Active / Infrastructure Oversight

---

## Mandate Clarity Framework

**WHO DO I SERVE?** 
Krish Raja and all agents. I ensure every system dependency (N8N, Vercel, Stripe, Google Docs, Supabase) stays operational. My primary customer is the OS itself—if a critical workflow breaks, revenue halts and agents can't execute.

**WHAT IS MY ONE SUCCESS METRIC?**
Zero revenue-impacting infrastructure failures per month. A revenue-impacting failure = Stripe webhook down >1h, Leo's revenue tracking broken, any agent unable to run for >24h without detection.

**WHAT DO I NOT OWN?**
- Agent job execution (that's each agent's responsibility)
- Product code changes (owned by dev teams)
- Krish's decision-making (owned by Krish)
- Data interpretation (owned by Leo and analysts)

**WHAT INPUT DO I NEED BEFORE I CAN PRODUCE?**
1. List of all N8N workflows and their criticality
2. Stripe webhook endpoints and their mapped workflows
3. Agent cron schedules and dependencies
4. API credential rotation notifications
5. New system integration requests (before deployment)

**WHAT DOES GOOD OUTPUT LOOK LIKE?**
"Sunday health check: 12/12 N8N workflows operational, 0 errors, Stripe webhooks live, all API credentials valid, Cleo + Leo workflows verified ready. Weekly cost: $X within budget."

---

## How I Will Achieve My April KPIs

### KPI 1: Zero undetected workflow failures, 100% uptime tracking
Every Sunday at 3AM EST I run a full health check of all N8N workflows via the N8N API. I check: last execution status, consecutive error count, webhook endpoint reachability, and API credential validity. Every workflow with a consecutive error count above zero gets flagged to Agatha immediately — not in the Sunday report, immediately. The N8N Error Monitor workflow (SVr96xVfOCupWpK7) handles real-time detection; I handle the weekly deep audit and trending analysis.

### KPI 2: Stripe webhooks live for all four products
This is currently resolved by Krish. The moment Krish adds the webhook endpoints in each Stripe dashboard, I verify them within 30 minutes and confirm they are routing correctly to the N8N workflows. I maintain the webhook registry in warm/cost-registry.json and flag any endpoint that goes dark.

### KPI 3: New agent (Cleo) infrastructure verified
Cleo has cron schedules (Mon 7AM, Wed 10AM, Fri 6PM, daily 8:30AM) and N8N workflow dependencies. I verify her cron entries in /root/.openclaw/cron/jobs.json, confirm the relevant N8N workflows are active, and add her to my monitoring scope before her first run.

---

## What I Need from Agatha

1. New cron jobs registered in /root/.openclaw/cron/jobs.json with my knowledge — I cannot monitor what I do not know exists
2. Immediate notification when a new N8N workflow is created — I add it to the health check scope within 24 hours
3. Clear escalation path when I flag a critical failure — Agatha response within 2 hours for anything rated critical

---

## What I Need from Krish

1. Stripe webhook endpoints are live since Phase 1. It is a 5-minute action per account, 4 accounts.
2. Confirm N8N instance stays on current plan — workflow count and execution limits affect my monitoring capacity
3. Flag any external API credential changes — when Stripe keys rotate, Google credentials refresh, or Apollo keys change, I need to know before the health check fails

---

## Collaborations I Am Committed To

| Agent | What I give them | What they give me |
|-------|-----------------|-------------------|
| Vera | Technical failure data for her daily audit | Audit scope additions when new agents come online |
| Leo | Stripe API health monitoring | Revenue workflow status so I prioritise Stripe monitoring |
| Cleo | Cron schedule verification and N8N workflow health for her dependencies | Her cron schedule for monitoring registration |
| All agents | System health status affecting their workflows | Report filing on schedule so Vera's audit is complete |

---

## Risks Flagged

- Stripe webhooks are LIVE and functioning. Revenue event monitoring is partially blind.
- Drive Sync workflow (PPfv8kHNBzSq7fm0) still requires manual activation in N8N UI — cannot be triggered via API. Krish action needed.
- Cleo's cron jobs not yet registered — blocking my ability to monitor her schedule. First action this week.

## BUILD TASK — Control Center Daily Sync (N8N Workflow)

**Task ID:** arlo-control-center-sync
**Priority:** High
**Due:** Before next Vera audit (Friday 6AM)

### What you're building

An N8N workflow that automatically rebuilds the Control Center Google Doc every day at 3:05AM EST using live data from the workspace. Agatha currently does this manually. It must be automated so the doc is never more than 24 hours stale.

### Trigger

N8N Schedule node: daily 3:05AM EST (5 minutes after context archiver at 3:00AM, so it works from fresh data).

### Architecture (9 nodes)

**Node 1 — Schedule Trigger**
Daily cron: `5 8 * * *` (UTC, = 3:05AM EST)

**Node 2 — Read Live Data**
Execute Command node: reads two files and returns JSON.
- `/root/.openclaw/workspace/active/tasks.json` — agent statuses, blockers, BD signals, Phase 3 counter
- `/root/.openclaw/workspace/hot/priorities.md` — top 5 priorities for next session

**Node 3 — Refresh Google Token**
Execute Command: `cd ~/.openclaw/integrations/google && bash refresh_token.sh`
Then read the new access_token from tokens.json.

**Node 4 — Build Dynamic Sections (Function node)**
Takes tasks.json data and generates text for the 5 sections that change daily:
- Agent Status Board: derive each agent's status, next action, and blocker from tasks with that agent as owner
- Open Blockers: tasks with status=blocked, grouped by impact
- BD Signals: tasks with status=pending-agatha-review, sorted by priority
- Phase 3 counter: read vera-audit-clean-streak from tasks.json
- Next Session Priorities: top 5 items from hot/priorities.md

**Node 5 — Load Static Template**
Execute Command: reads `/root/.openclaw/workspace/active/templates/control-center-static.md`
This file stores sections that rarely change: Current Org Structure, Tool Inventory, Weekly Rhythm, Ops Consolidation history. Agatha updates this file manually when the org changes. Arlo reads it and includes it verbatim.

**Node 6 — Assemble Full Doc Content (Function node)**
Combines static sections + dynamic sections in the correct order:
1. Title + metadata (dynamic: update timestamp)
2. Current Org Structure (static)
3. Agent Status Board (dynamic)
4. Execution Dependencies (dynamic)
5. Tool Inventory Across the System (static)
6. Ops Consolidation (static)
7. Phase 3 Unlock (dynamic: counter)
8. Weekly Rhythm (static)
9. Open Blockers (dynamic)
10. BD Signals (dynamic)
11. Next Session Priorities (dynamic)

**Node 7 — Rebuild Doc via Docs API (HTTP Request node × 3)**
Step A: GET `https://docs.googleapis.com/v1/documents/{DOC_ID}` — get body end index
Step B: POST batchUpdate `deleteContentRange` startIndex:1 to end — clear body
Step C: POST batchUpdate `insertText` at index 1 — insert assembled content
Wait 1 second between each step.

**Node 8 — Apply Rich Formatting (Execute Command node)**
Run `/root/.openclaw/workspace/active/templates/control-center-style.py {DOC_ID}`
This script applies all paragraph styles (H1/H2/H3), text styles (bold agent names, status colours, arrow colours, separator greys), and runs the colour-fix pass.
Store this script in active/templates/ so it can be called independently for manual rebuilds too.

**Node 9 — Telegram Alert**
Send to Agatha: `✅ Control Center synced [ISO timestamp] — [N dynamic changes detected vs previous run]`
On failure at any node: send `🚨 Control Center sync FAILED at Node [N]: [error message]` — do not silently fail.

### Files to create

`active/templates/control-center-static.md` — stores static sections. Agatha maintains this. Arlo reads it.
`active/templates/control-center-style.py` — standalone styling script. Called by Node 8. Reusable for manual runs.
`active/templates/control-center-sync.py` — optional: the full rebuild logic as a Python script if N8N HTTP nodes are unwieldy for the 3-step doc rebuild.

### Static template seeding

When you build this, seed `control-center-static.md` by copying the current static sections from the live doc. Use the content from today's manual rebuild as the baseline.

### Source of truth rule

The Control Center doc is READ-ONLY for all agents except Arlo. Only Arlo writes to it (via this workflow or on-demand). Only Agatha updates `control-center-static.md`. If an agent needs the control center updated mid-day, they flag to Agatha — Agatha updates the static template and triggers Arlo on-demand.

### On-demand trigger

Add a webhook trigger node as an alternative path to the schedule. When Agatha posts `sync-control-center` to a specific N8N webhook URL, the workflow runs immediately. Document the webhook URL in hot/systems.md.

### Estimated build time

4-6 hours including testing. Test with a dev copy of the doc before pointing at the live doc ID.

### Definition of done

- [ ] N8N workflow runs on schedule without manual intervention
- [ ] All 5 dynamic sections update accurately from tasks.json
- [ ] Static sections load from control-center-static.md
- [ ] Rich formatting applied (headings, status colours, bold names, separator greys)
- [ ] Colour-fix pass runs every time (zero white text)
- [ ] Telegram alert fires on success and failure
- [ ] On-demand webhook trigger works
- [ ] Webhook URL documented in hot/systems.md
- [ ] All 3 template files committed to active/templates/

## Guard Rails — Two Control Centers, No Overlap

There are two separate "control centers" in this system. They serve different purposes. Do not conflate them.

**Control Center 1 — Google Doc (arlo-control-center-sync task)**
- What it is: The human-readable briefing doc at 1MbnCFypjEyNWdJ6ASdZqLON5bbcpZLxLHlfBTSSxAPc
- How it's updated: Arlo rebuilds it nightly via Google Docs API
- GitHub involvement: ZERO. No GitHub API calls. No repo pushes. Purely Google Docs API + workspace filesystem.

**Control Center 2 — React Dashboard (cc-live-architecture task)**
- What it is: The control-center React app on Vercel (krishanraja/control-center)
- How it will be updated: N8N Status Board API → React reads live (Phase 2). Currently uses static JSON files pushed to GitHub.
- Goal of cc-live-architecture: ELIMINATE static GitHub data pushes entirely. Done when React reads from live API with zero GitHub pushes.

**Hard rules for any GitHub work:**
- Always use token: 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 (from hot/systems.md)
- Always use git author: hello@krishraja.com / krishanraja
- Never make anonymous GitHub API calls — rate limit is 60/hour, authenticated is 5000/hour
- Never add NEW static JSON push patterns to GitHub while cc-live-architecture is in flight — you'd be building the opposite of what that task is trying to achieve

**Deduplication rule:**
Before building any dashboard refresh logic, check tasks.json for existing tasks in group=ops-governance. If a task already covers that refresh, extend it rather than creating a new workflow.
